## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new flag should honor its required environment default so CI exclusions take effect.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable filename glob exclusions, skip logging, flag documentation, and tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the --exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, you still archive `.log` files because `default=[]` ignores the environment. This violates “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`). — CI jobs configuring exclusions through the mandated environment variable silently include files they intended to skip.
